crosscheck.note: the live check's saved 24-hour radar total for the operator, for the 24 hours ending at each midnight, America/Chicago, against this record's total for that calendar day (the wettest rain point), where either is at least 0.05 inch; an indication only while the saved live readings are incomplete (hours with no reading for an operator are not compared)

method: Each operator's storms since 2015 (runs of days with at least 0.1 inch of rain at its combined sewer outfalls, NOAA MRMS radar) are paired with its own dated overflow reports. Discharge is possible from the smallest storm it ever reported an overflow after, rounded down to a step, and likely from the smallest step at which it reported an overflow after at least half of the storms of that size and of all larger storms together. Below the possible amount no caution is shown only when at least 30 storms that small are on record and none was followed by a report.
